title: ObjectIdentity
description: Represents an identity used to sign in to a user account.

signInType.description: Specifies the type of user sign-in (e.g. emailAddress, userName, userPrincipalName).

issuer.description: Specifies the issuer of the identity, for example contoso.onmicrosoft.com.

issuerAssignedId.description: Specifies the unique value associated with the issuer- signInType combination.
